question: Can the validated camera-angular boundary factor be expanded to new Bonn FIT parents using source-native RGB-D without requiring complete support or obstacle truth?

inputs.dataset_role: eight frozen Bonn FIT parents only

factor_contract.metric_depth: source-native metric depth with A_SOURCE tier on valid pixels
factor_contract.boundary_core: conservative point-to-plane discontinuity derived from source depth
factor_contract.continuous_boundary: pixel distance/soft probability plus camera-ray angular distance/soft probability at sigma 0.012 rad
factor_contract.support: UNKNOWN on every pixel because gravity/support evidence is not locked for this source slice
factor_contract.obstacle_evidence: UNKNOWN on every pixel because support-relative evidence is unavailable

decision.next_execution: Add this Bonn FIT label directory and RGB binding as a third masked-training source with source-balanced sampling; train one boundary-only angular probe while keeping all sealed Bonn/ICL roles out of optimization and selection.

claim_boundary: WILD_LAB corpus expansion using source-native depth and deterministic angular-boundary derivation. It demonstrates usable incomplete factor labels, not complete truth, support/obstacle supervision, dataset-license clearance, task utility, formal F1 authorization, safety, deployment, or product performance.
